title: Character position jump between platforms during normal traversal
reproduction_steps: Move character left and right across floating platforms using directional keys
Observe character traveling through the level as camera scrolls
suspected_cause: Normal gameplay movement and camera scrolling across a platformer level; the 'sudden_jump' flag likely triggered by rapid scene change from jumping/scrolling rather than an actual visual glitch.
evidence_note: Frames 31 through 62 show continuous, coherent platformer traversal with consistent art style, character, and physics; no teleportation, corrupted geometry, or discontinuity is visible. Pixel diff median is actually lower than clean play median, suggesting less motion, not a jump artifact.
